items.title: Danube water levels: Hungary, Romania cut nuclear output
items.description: Historically low water levels along Europe's second-longest river have led Hungary and Romania to reduce output at key nuclear plants. Danube tourism and river cargo have also been severely affected by Europe's heatwave.

items.title: India news: Assam flood toll rises to 78, more rain predicted
items.description: Monsoon floods in Assam have left 78 people dead so far as thousands remain displaced. Opposition lawmakers have staged a protest in the Indian parliament. DW has the latest.

items.description: UEFA is reportedly soon to hold an emergency meeting to discuss FIFA's plans to effectively sell off a stake in the World Cup. European football's governing body has expressed stiff opposition to the plan.

items.title: How well are LGBTQ+ rights protected across Europe?
items.description: After the attack on Berlin’s Pride event on Saturday, the situation of the LGBTQ+ community in Germany is a topic of conversation. How well are queer rights protected in other European countries? An overview.
